AuditRecordRow.description:
``GET /records?case_id=``: one record in the web's row shape
(``AuditRecord`` in ``src/frontend/src/api/types/analyst.ts``): ``by`` is
the actor, ``what`` the summary, ``at`` the append time.
AuditRecordRow.title: AuditRecordRow

ChainHead.description:
``GET /head/{case_id}``: the case chain's head, which a pack records so
it can later prove which records it was built from. A case with no records
has ``seq=0`` and the genesis hash.
ChainHead.title: ChainHead

Completion.description:
Filled over required fields, rounded half up, as the server computes it
(the client never does arithmetic on these).
Completion.title: Completion

ControlInput.description:
One control's rating as confirmed (or AI-proposed) for scoring.
A planned control must never appear here (rule 7); the engine does not
special-case it — it is the caller's job to exclude it.
ControlInput.title: ControlInput

ControlInventoryOut.description:
``GET /controls?version=&domain=``: a control inventory version,
optionally narrowed to one risk domain.
ControlInventoryOut.title: ControlInventoryOut

CreateCaseBody.description: ``POST /cases``: both fields are optional; the web posts ``{}``.
CreateCaseBody.title: CreateCaseBody

DemoUser.description: One person on the local demo picker (``GET /auth/demo-users``).
DemoUser.title: DemoUser

DemoUserGroup.description: The demo picker's people of one role, with the heading the page shows.
DemoUserGroup.title: DemoUserGroup

Domain.description: The four FFIEC risk domains (scoring v3 / design A §5).
Domain.title: Domain

EmptyBody.description:
``POST validate`` and ``POST submit`` carry no input: the server reads the
case. The web posts ``{}``.
EmptyBody.title: EmptyBody

JurisdictionVersionOut.title: JurisdictionVersionOut

LoginRequest.description:
Credentials for ``POST /login``.

Exactly one of ``username`` (the web form's field; the seed id without its
``u-`` prefix) or ``email`` (the original contract field; either spelling
of the seed id) names the account. ``password`` may be empty only for the
local demo picker (see ``fcrm_identity.settings.IdentitySettings
.demo_login_active``); everywhere else an empty password is just a wrong
one.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

LoginResponse.description:
What every login-family route answers with.

The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie and never appears in the body.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

OriginalValue.description: What a value held before the owner corrected it (the original is kept).
OriginalValue.title: OriginalValue

Outcome.description:
Four outcomes required by the brief; no fifth value, ever (rule: nothing
is approved or rejected automatically).
Outcome.title: Outcome

PrecedentPO.description:
The closest closed case: its title, unit and closed month, and which of
its values may be reused. Never its outcome, rating or similarity.
PrecedentPO.title: PrecedentPO

PrincipalOut.description:
A person as the web shows them: the login ``user`` and ``GET /me``.

``id`` is the seed id (``u-riyer``), which is the JWT ``sub`` and the key
every other service stores (``analyst_id``, ``owner``).
PrincipalOut.title: PrincipalOut

Proposal.description:
A stored proposal. ``seq`` is the case's own monotonic ledger number
(one sequence per case, so it is also monotonic within a run);
``superseded_by`` is derived on read from the proposal that names this
one in its ``supersedes``.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposalAppend.description:
``POST /proposals``: one validated agent output for the evidence
ledger. ``kind`` is open (``extraction``, ``category``, ``gaps``,
``screening``, ``research``, ``assessment``, ``critic``, ``narrative``,
``completeness``, ``examiner``, ``watchlist``, ``reflag`` ...) so a new
agent needs no contract change; ``supersedes`` names the earlier proposal
this one replaces (a later version is a new document: the ledger never
updates one).
ProposalAppend.title: ProposalAppend

ProposalTokens.description:
Token usage of the model call that produced a proposal (the keys of
``AgentDone.usage``); all zero for a proposal no model call produced.
ProposalTokens.title: ProposalTokens

RecordAppend.description:
What the caller submits; ``prev_hash``/``hash``/``seq`` are computed
by the service, never supplied by the caller.
RecordAppend.title: RecordAppend

RefreshRequest.description:
Non-browser clients may send the refresh token in the body instead
of relying on the cookie (design A §8.1: "cookie or {refresh_token}").
Not a shared contract shape (no other service calls this): kept local
to this package rather than added to ``fcrm_contracts`` on this pass.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

ReleaseChecks.description:
The four release checks before a pack may go to committee (design A
§3.1 "proposed enumeration", mirrors SubmitCaseChecks in spirit).
ReleaseChecks.title: ReleaseChecks

ResolvedFieldSetOut.description:
``GET /field-sets/{version}/resolve?change_types=a,b``: the fields a
case with those change types must fill (the always-required set, then each
type's own fields in the order the types were given, de-duplicated by
field id). Each per-type field carries the change type that adds it.
ResolvedFieldSetOut.title: ResolvedFieldSetOut

RosterUser.description:
One entry of ``GET /users?role=``: who can be assigned or can vote.

Deliberately narrower than :class:`PrincipalOut`: no title, no account
flags, never a credential.
RosterUser.title: RosterUser

RoutingRule.description: One of R1..R6 as data (ADR-19 as D-19 origin; routing v4).
RoutingRule.title: RoutingRule

SourceRef.description:
A page:line pointer into a stored document; ``label`` is the display
form, e.g. ``business_case.pdf p.4 l.12``.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

ValidateResponse.description:
What ``/core/validate`` returns to nginx's ``auth_request`` and to any
service that falls back to it when JWKS is unavailable.
ValidateResponse.title: ValidateResponse

VoteOption.description:
Mirrors Outcome; kept distinct so a cast vote and a tallied outcome are
never structurally confusable.
VoteOption.title: VoteOption

info.description: Every service of the api process under its public prefix (X1 /api/fcrm/auth, S1 /api/fcrm, S2 /scoring, S3 /policy, S4 /audit, S5 /decision).
info.title: TrustOps API

get.description:
The last ``seq`` and hash of ``case_id``'s chain (``seq=0`` and the
genesis hash for a case with no records): what a pack records so it can
later show which records it was built from.

One page of ``case_id``'s proposals in ``seq`` order, optionally for
one run, one agent and one kind.

post.description:
Append one validated agent output to the case's evidence ledger. The
ledger is append-only: a later version of a proposal is a new entry whose
``supersedes`` names the one it replaces. A repeated ``Idempotency-Key``
returns the proposal it already stored with 200.

200.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the proposal already stored.

409.description: The key was used for a different request, or `supersedes` already has a successor.

get.description:
One page of ``case_id``'s chain in the web's row shape (web path
``audit/records?case_id=``), in ``seq`` order, oldest first.

post.description:
Append one record to ``body.case_id``'s chain. The only chain write
route S4 exposes (design A §2.4; ``docs/governance/audit-chain.md``).
A repeated ``Idempotency-Key`` returns the record it already wrote with
200 and appends nothing.

200.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the record already stored.

409.description: The key was used for a different request.

get.description: One page of ``case_id``'s chain, in ``seq`` order, oldest first.

Recompute ``case_id``'s whole chain and report whether it is
intact, and the first broken ``seq`` if not (``fcrm_audit.chain.
verify_chain``, the only place a chain is ever verified). A case with
no records yet verifies trivially (``ok=True``, ``record_count=0``).
Alias of ``POST /core/validate`` (design A §8.1).

post.description:
The AEO contract kept for nginx's ``auth_request`` (``ops/nginx``)
and for any service falling back to it when JWKS is unreachable.
``current_user`` already rejects a non-access, expired or badly
signed token with 401 before this body ever runs (bug 1's fix, shared
with every other service via :class:`fcrm_common.auth.TokenVerifier`).

get.description:
The seeded people grouped for the web's demo picker. Unauthenticated
by design (it is shown before anyone has signed in) and therefore
available only where password-less login is
(:attr:`IdentitySettings.demo_login_active`).

Raises:
    NotFoundError: Demo mode is off or ``ENV`` is not local -- the same
        404 an unknown route gets, so the endpoint does not advertise
        itself.

schema.title: Response Demo Users Demo Users Get

post.description:
Password login for a seeded user. Rate-limited at the gateway
(nginx ``limit_req zone=fcrm_login``), not here.

The account is named by ``username`` or ``email`` (exactly one, see
:class:`~fcrm_contracts.api.identity.LoginRequest`). When the local demo
picker is on (:attr:`IdentitySettings.demo_login_active`) an *empty*
password signs the named, enabled user in without a hash check; in every
other environment an empty password is checked like any other and fails.

Raises:
    UnauthorizedError: Unknown login, disabled account or wrong
        password -- one message for all three, so the response never
        reveals which it was.

Revoke the caller's refresh token (if one is presented and still
decodes) and clear the cookie. Always 204: logging out an
already-expired session is not an error.

get.description: The caller's own profile (id, name, roles, title, unit).

post.description:
Rotate a refresh token for a new access token.

Raises:
    UnauthorizedError: No refresh token presented, it is not a
        ``refresh``-typed token (rejects an access token here, the
        mirror image of bug 1), it was never issued, is revoked or
        expired, or its owner is no longer enabled.

get.description:
The enabled people holding ``role``: the roster R5 auto-triage picks
an analyst from and committee release counts members against. OPA lets
analysts, committee members and the service account call it
(``permissions.json``'s ``identity-get-users-...`` rule).
Alias of ``GET /me`` (design A §8.1).
The owner's cases, newest first; ``stage`` and ``needs_response`` filter.

post.description: Raise a draft case: the id is minted and the versions in force pinned.

get.description: The case header, stage and what the owner does next.
The owner's activity feed, newest first, in plain words.

post.description: Discard an unsubmitted draft, with a reason.

get.description: The Documents tab.

post.description:
Upload files (multipart ``files``), or use the committed demo documents
(JSON ``{"demo_files": [...]}``). Each file is checked, stored and announced
to Caseflow in one transaction.

get.description: The Overview tab: proposed types, values with sources, precedent, questions.

post.description: Answer the assistant's questions (one decision per question).
Confirm or remove one proposed change type (a removal needs a reason).
Reuse values from the precedent the assistant found.
Confirm or correct one value; a correction keeps the original.

get.description: The Review & submit tab.

The case's live event stream (``fcrm_case.sse``): unnamed frames
``id: <seq>`` / ``data: {type, caseId, seq, at, payload}``.

``Last-Event-ID`` (or ``?last_event_id=``) replays everything after that
``seq`` from the activity log; without one the stream starts at the case's
current head. A PO must own the case (another PO's case is a 404) and is
shown ``po``/``all`` entries only, never score, harness or audit events;
analysts, committee members, observers and the service account are shown
the analyst feed too.

post.description: Run the four checks again and submit; 422 names the failing check.
A dry run of the four submit checks (always 200).

get.description: The owner's KPIs and open cases.

post.description:
Build a new pack version, or hand back the current one unchanged.

``pack_unchanged`` (by content hash) is a no-op: the same pack id and
version come back, no new row is written. Any real content change --
including a number corrected after an R6 unlock -- mints a new pack id
and version, and supersedes the previous one (its votes are voided,
never deleted: design A §3.6 "pack v2").

get.description: A pack by id, for a committee member's or analyst's own lookup.

The persisted tally result for a pack's latest round.

Raises :class:`ConflictError` (409) while quorum has not yet been
reached -- there is no outcome to read, and none is ever invented.

post.description:
R6: open a committee question thread on ``pack_id``, visible to
every member and the analyst. ``body.asked_by`` must be the caller
(403 otherwise). There is no ``Thread`` shape in
``fcrm_contracts.api.decision`` yet, so the response echoes the
question with a minted ``question_id`` as a plain object rather than
inventing a new contract type.

schema.title: Response Ask Question Packs  Pack Id  Questions Post

get.description:
Before quorum: :class:`VotesHidden` (a count only, R2). Once the
requested round has been tallied, its votes are revealed with full
rationale and the tally -- never before.

schema.title: Response Vote Status Packs  Pack Id  Votes Get

post.description:
Cast one committee member's vote.

The member is the caller: ``body.member_id`` must equal the verified
``principal.sub`` (403 otherwise), so no token can vote in another
member's name and the one-vote-per-member rule binds to real identity.

Hidden until quorum (R2): the response is always either
``VotesHidden`` (a count, never a vote) while fewer than
:data:`QUORUM` members have voted this round, or the freshly computed
``OutcomeSet`` *only once the third vote has just landed* -- the
voter who completes the round learns the outcome because quorum is,
by definition, reached; nobody before that point can.

schema.title: Response Cast Vote Packs  Pack Id  Votes Post

post.description:
R6: attach the analyst's answer as a pack addendum.
``body.answered_by`` must be the caller (403 otherwise).

``numbers_changed=True`` unlocks the pack immediately: it stops
accepting votes and its already-cast votes for the open round are
voided (kept for audit, never deleted). No new pack is built here --
the real "did a number change" detection and the corrected content
both live with whatever calls this service (H1 caseflow); S5's job is
only to act on the flag once it is told. The next ``POST /packs`` for
this case, carrying the corrected snapshot, is what actually produces
pack v2 and so re-requests every vote (a fresh, empty round on a new
pack id).

schema.title: Response Answer Question Questions  Question Id  Answers Post

post.description:
Re-derive the four release checks through the pure
``evaluate_release_checks`` rather than trusting a pre-built
``ReleaseChecks`` object -- a thin, stateless wrapper a caller can poll
before assembling a pack's snapshot.

get.description: The owner's integrations and their choices.

post.description: Connect an integration to a location or channel, or disconnect it.

get.description:
One control-inventory version (``v9`` or ``9``; the active one when
omitted), optionally only the controls of one risk ``domain``.
Every stored control-inventory version, the active one flagged.
One field-set version (``v6`` or ``6``; ``latest`` is the active one).

The fields a case with ``change_types`` must fill at this field-set
version: always-required first, then each type's own fields in the order
given (the same arithmetic as S1's ``resolve_required_fields``).

One jurisdiction list: ``version`` is a version id (``v2026-06``),
``latest``/``current`` or none for the active list, or ``fixture`` for the
synthetic re-flag list.
Every stored jurisdiction list version, the active one flagged.

post.description:
Hybrid search over one of the three indexes (``policy_clauses``,
``precedent_cases``, ``controls``): rank fusion of a keyword ranking
(Mongo ``$text``) and, for ``policy_clauses``, H4's semantic ranking,
with the Index Contract's metadata filters pushed down to both.

get.description: The scoring model version currently active for new scoring calls.

A pinned scoring model version, for replaying an older case's
score exactly (every case pins the version it was scored with).
The routing rules version currently active (R1-R6, D-19).

post.description:
Compute a composite score. Idempotent and pure given the same
``body`` and the active model matching ``body.scoring_v`` — called by
H1 after assessment proposals land, by the review-item override path,
and by nothing else (design A §3.1; ADR-07: no agent calls this).
